title: SeedreamまたはGPT-Image-2で画像を生成し、その画像をSeedance 2.0に入れて動画化するワークフローで作る
content:
SeedreamまたはGPT-Image-2で画像を生成し、その画像をSeedance 2.0に入れて動画化するワークフローで作る
目薬をさす→「来たー！」と叫ぶ→好きな場所で「○○へようこそ」と言う、の3カット構成で動画を作る

en.content:
Create a video using a workflow where you generate an image with Seedream or GPT-Image-2, and then animate it with Seedance 2.0. The video should consist of three cuts: applying eye drops → shouting "It's here!" → saying "Welcome to ○○" at your favorite place.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#AIOutfitChallenge
I left it to 🍌 to create this gal outfit, but would anyone like to wear it? 😉
This time, the reference image is a mannequin 💦
Feel free to use the outfit with the tag and quoted post 👍
Outfits in the highlights are also OK 💖 https://t.co/JMaq0zsCPx
---
